# Richard Passos Portfolio

> A multilingual developer portfolio showcasing Richard Passos' projects, professional experience, technical skills, and education. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, and modern web technologies.

Important notes:

- This portfolio is a single-page application organized into sections rather than multiple pages.
- Content is available in English and Portuguese.
- Projects include descriptions, technologies used, links to source code, and live demos when available.
- The portfolio focuses on frontend engineering, full-stack web development, software architecture, accessibility, and performance.

## Experience

- [/#work](https://richardp.vercel.app/#experience): Professional experience, internships, previous roles, responsibilities, and achievements.

## Projects

- [/#projects](https://richardp.vercel.app/#projects): Portfolio projects with descriptions, technology stack, and link to project's own page.

## About

- [/#about](https://richardp.vercel.app/#about): Personal introduction, background, interests, and development philosophy.

## Skills

- [/#skills](https://richardp.vercel.app/#skills): Technologies, frameworks, languages, tools, and areas of expertise.

## Contact

- [/#contact](https://richardp.vercel.app/#contact): Contact information and external profiles.

## Repository

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Richard-Passos/portfolio): Source code, setup instructions, architecture, and implementation details.

## Technologies

- Next.js (App Router)
- React
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- GSAP
- next-intlayer
- Vercel

## Audience

This portfolio is intended for recruiters, hiring managers, developers, collaborators, and anyone interested in Richard Passos' work or technical background.
